field_contract.commit_sha: full actual Git object ID, never fabricated; null only for UNBOUND_LEGACY_EVIDENCE
field_contract.branch: branch at verification; detached state explicitly recorded
field_contract.source_manifest_hash: sha256-prefixed digest; REQUIRED for dirty source, recommended for all new verification
field_contract.input_manifest_ref: portable repository/archive ref to exact verification input manifest
field_contract.runner_version: source digest or immutable version pinned to commit
field_contract.verifier_version: source digest or immutable version pinned to commit
field_contract.external_asset_refs: array of logical ID, version, digest, provenance/license and portable archive refs
field_contract.verification_time: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp from actual user verification
field_contract.final_decision: actual user-terminal/final-audit result, never inferred from field existence
field_contract.notion_receipt_ref: null until actual sync receipt; non-null required for ENGINEERING_FROZEN

rules: New execution must capture actual source and inputs before verification and detect changes before binding.
worktree_dirty=true requires source_manifest_hash; HEAD alone is insufficient.
Clean HEAD also requires external inputs/dependency environment to be pinned; Git alone does not identify models/data.
commit_sha denotes source at verification; if a later freeze commit differs, record freeze_commit_sha separately and prove relevant source equality.
Dirty verified files must match approved committed blobs and modes before ENGINEERING_FROZEN.
Artifacts are not modified retrospectively to pretend they came from a newer commit.
Legacy artifacts retain UNBOUND_LEGACY_EVIDENCE; hashes of their present bytes do not prove historical source identity.
Invalid/missing bindings block freeze; they do not retroactively change a recorded functional outcome.
Documents and Notion receipts cannot substitute for source validation.
No credentials, authentication URL segments or secret values in any binding.
All refs use repository-relative paths or portable archive identifiers; canonical_root is execution context, not a portability dependency.

hash_strategy.ordering: UTF-8 byte order; exact repository-relative literal paths
hash_strategy.per_file: Hash raw file bytes, plus record Git executable mode; no symlink traversal.
hash_strategy.source_digest: Hash unambiguous length-prefixed path, mode, size and content digest tuples for approved verification-relevant source, config, schema, policy, fixture, dependency, runner and verifier files.
hash_strategy.self_reference: Exclude baseline_asset_disposition_v1.json and current_source_baseline_manifest_v1.json from their own raw digest aggregation; separately bind their reviewed inventory projection and final bytes in external freeze receipt. Never exclude executable inputs.
hash_strategy.inventory_projection: Sorted approved path, classification, maturity, decision and mode tuples; approval receipt identifies this exact projection.
hash_strategy.full_baseline: Actual commit tree binds all staged governance documents and source bytes; external receipt binds manifest raw digests without a circular commit SHA.
hash_strategy.large_external: Hash large external binaries before approval; record size, version, source, license and archive URI without moving them in this phase.
hash_strategy.security_sensitive: Do not hash or publish credential values as source evidence. Review/quarantine first; hash only approved sanitized source.
